correctness.rationale: Conditioning on M=z_k makes the other value uniformly distributed over z_(k+1),...,z_N. Set U_k=mean of that tail; the assumed regression makes U_k=z_k/2+c. The identity (N-k)U_k=z_(k+1)+(N-k-1)U_(k+1) yields (N-k+1)z_(k+1)=(N-k)z_k+2c, so successive differences are equal for all k<=N-2. Conversely arithmetic endpoints give E[S|M]=3M/2+(a+Nd)/2. For canonical z=1..N, direct covariance computation yields Var S=(N+1)(N-2)/6, Var M=(N+1)(N-2)/18 and Cov(M,S)=3 Var(M)/2, proving the exact correlation. Independent exact rational arithmetic sample checks support the all-N algebra; no finite search is substituted for the recurrence proof.
